note: Shared JSON Schema conformance corpus (M1-T01). Every instance carries the verdict that Python jsonschema (Draft 2020-12 with the date-time format checker) gives for it; tests/bundle/test_bundle.py checks those verdicts and crates/hoh-core/tests/schema_corpus.rs checks that the product validator agrees.

cases.note: dispatch with a free-form payload (unknown payload fields are kept)
reason_code may be null when not rejected
unknown event kind and payload fields are kept
event with ids and offset time
completed result with evidence and issues
if/then: rejected needs a non-null reason_code
type: string is not an integer
if/then minItems: verification needs acceptance ids
if/then: verification needs a task id
if/then required: role change needs state
format: date-time needs T and offset
anyOf: ConfigureTeam needs bindings or scheduler (CR-007)
json result of an INCOMPLETE run (CR-005)
json result of a run blocked before any specification exists
run result with an unknown field
last stream-json line: run.result carrying the run result
a run result line must be of kind run.result
run.result payload must be a complete run result
run.result is still an Event (seq required)
2 is no exit code of the table
a client that detached on SIGINT writes no run result (stderr notice only)
a run still running cannot end the client with 0
host unavailable: no run result, json stdout stays empty
a BLOCKED result names its blocked reason
only a BLOCKED result has a blocked reason
run.result is the persisted final event: never a running run
